value.rationale: The anisotropic weighted four-vertex cycle is a canonical minimal metric obstruction to nonexpansive commuting retractions. Its complete aspect-ratio profile shows strict failure of nonexpansiveness under any imbalance, a unique golden-ratio optimal distortion, and recovery toward contractivity for extreme imbalance. These exact geometric transitions and the unrestricted real-parameter classification give a mathematically motivated result beyond a single arbitrary finite table.
